correctness.rationale: Derive F(lambda,tau) from the specified positive equilibrium; solve two-frequency imaginary-root equation with correct opposite sine phases; verify simplicity and the exact derivative sign (omega^4-gamma^2)/|F_lambda|^2; use a uniform right-half-plane root bound and zero-delay Hurwitz stability to get the exact unstable-pair count for every noncritical delay; solve B_n<A_{n+1} and count integer windows; compute all family parameters exactly. A reproducible standalone checker verifies algebra, crossing signs and seven contour root counts. Simultaneous spectral crossings are excluded from stable open intervals, and neither finite experiments nor root-bound arguments are misused to prove global nonlinear stability.
